tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (8.1:1).

tokens.name: pure-white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: jet-black
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.logo`, `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`. 19.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: concrete-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav a`, `.page-date`, `.stat-label`. 2.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.card-category`, `.status-pending`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
